6-5.title: Parts of an Expression
6-5.context: Tickets cost $12 each, plus a flat $50 venue fee. Let t be the number of tickets: total = 12t + 50.
6-5.contextEs: Los boletos cuestan $12 cada uno, más una tarifa fija de $50 por el lugar. Sea t el número de boletos: total = 12t + 50.
guide: Each colour is one part. Tap a part to name it; the brackets under the expression show its terms.
Change one control at a time and watch which part changes.
investigate: Before you change anything: in 12t + 50, which number grows the total each time t goes up by 1, and which number is added only once?
Set the coefficient to 1. Why does the expression show t and not 1t? What is the coefficient now?
Change the operation to −. Is 50 still the constant? Is it still a term?
Set the constant to 0. How many terms are left?
Evaluate for t = 0, 1 and 2. Which part tells you how much the total grows each time?

term.definition: A part of an expression joined to the other parts by + or −. A term can be a number (50), a variable (t), or a number times a variable (12t).
term.definitionEs: Una parte de una expresión que se une a las otras partes con + o −. Un término puede ser un número (50), una variable (t) o un número por una variable (12t).
